title: fix(alerts): link notifications to the incident page

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review f92647ed-24b9-4f20-ac25-f16518dda32d 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
The new link form matches the dashboard's own incident links; only the webhook path is pinned by a test, push and chat-digest links are not.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Alert notifications now link to `/alerts/incidents/<id>` when the delivery carries an incident, and keep the service page or `/alerts` for rule-test sends. The change is small and consistent with the ids the dashboard itself uses.

- `composeLinkUrl` prefers the incident page over the service page
- `resolveNotificationLinkUrl` passes `row.incidentId` / `incident.id` at four call sites
- Rule-test deliveries still link to `/alerts`

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- The web route `/alerts/incidents/$incidentId` accepts the internal id the delivery rows store: the dashboard links it the same way (`apps/web/src/page/alerts/hub/hub.scene.test.ts:78`).
- Chat digests render each item's own `linkUrl` (`delivery/chat-digest.ts:33`), so digest lines link per incident.
- The rule-test path keeps `/alerts` because `AlertDestinationsService.ts:973` calls `composeLinkUrl(null)`, and the new test fails against the old fallback.

</details>

<sub>`702b56e` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>

Alert notifications now link to `/alerts/incidents/<id>` instead of the service page, keeping the service or `/alerts` fallback when the delivery has no incident. Contained, correct, safe to merge.

- `composeLinkUrl` prefers `/alerts/incidents/<id>` over the service page
- Mobile push digests use a rule-level link; single pushes keep the incident
- Chat digest lines each carry their incident's own link

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- `/alerts/incidents/$incidentId` is a real dashboard route (`apps/web/src/route/route.test.ts:78`)
- The digest link comes only from `pushBudget.claim`'s `linkUrl` (`alert-push-budget.ts:103`)
- `row.incidentId` is nullable on both dispatch and digest paths, so the null fallback still reaches the service page

</details>
